items.prompt: A modest residential courtyard between city apartment blocks on a wet, overcast spring morning: a car tyre painted a pale colour, lying flat in the courtyard and used as a flower bed for low marigolds. Beyond it a path, a pedestrian crossing and, at the edge of frame, a corner pharmacy window with a sun-bleached poster of an indistinct family. A man of about forty in a dark jacket, seen from behind, stands still on the path as if he had forgotten the way. Nobody else.

alt.ru: Мокрый двор: крашеная шина с бархатцами вместо клумбы, дальше витрина аптеки, на дорожке спиной к нам замер мужчина.
alt.en: A wet courtyard: a painted tyre with marigolds for a flower bed, a pharmacy window beyond, a man standing still on the path with his back to us.
alt.pt: Um pátio molhado: um pneu pintado com cravos-de-defunto no lugar do canteiro, ao fundo a vitrine da farmácia, um homem parado de costas no caminho.
alt.es: Un patio mojado: un neumático pintado con tagetes en lugar de macizo, al fondo el escaparate de la farmacia, un hombre inmóvil de espaldas en el camino.

caption.ru: Аптека, двор, жёлтая шина. Эту дорогу три года знали его ноги.
caption.en: The pharmacy, the courtyard, the yellow tyre. For three years his feet had known this way.
caption.pt: A farmácia, o pátio, o pneu amarelo. Havia três anos os pés dele sabiam esse caminho.
caption.es: La farmacia, el patio, el neumático amarillo. Sus pies llevaban tres años sabiendo este camino.

items.prompt: A small neighbourhood cafe on a rainy morning, wet umbrellas by the door. Close view of a table: a man's hand laid over a woman's hand, on her wrist a blank paper baggage tag. Two cups, one untouched, a teaspoon on a saucer. Their faces are out of frame. In the blurred background the barista, seen from behind, is busy with a milk jug.

alt.ru: Столик в кафе: мужская ладонь лежит поверх женской, у женщины на запястье бумажная бирка от багажа, рядом две чашки.
alt.en: A cafe table: a man's hand lies over a woman's, a paper baggage tag on her wrist, two cups beside them.
alt.pt: Mesa de café: a mão de um homem sobre a de uma mulher, no pulso dela uma etiqueta de papel da bagagem, ao lado duas xícaras.
alt.es: Mesa de café: la mano de un hombre sobre la de una mujer, en la muñeca de ella una etiqueta de papel del equipaje, al lado dos tazas.

caption.ru: Бирку от багажа она забыла снять.
caption.en: She had forgotten to take off the baggage tag.
caption.pt: A etiqueta da bagagem ela esquecera de tirar.
caption.es: La etiqueta del equipaje se le había olvidado quitarla.
